lessons.title: Vocabulário
lessons.goal: Aprender o vocabulário da unidade: Success and ambition (ambition, achievement, setback, resilience, mentor, opportunity, self-confidence, challenge, motivated, career path).

head: Palavra
Significado
Exemplo
rows: She is very ambitious and wants to run the company.
Finishing the marathon was a great achievement.
Losing the contract was a serious setback.
Resilience helps you recover from failure.
My mentor taught me how to lead a team.
This job is a great opportunity for growth.
He feels motivated when he sees progress.
What career path would you like to follow?
She has a lot of potential.

items: **achieve / reach** a goal; **set** a target; **pursue** a career; **realise** your potential
**take** a risk; **seize** an opportunity; **overcome** an obstacle; **face** a challenge
**make** progress; **gain** experience; **meet** a deadline; **climb** the career ladder
**have** a lot of potential; **work** your way up; **handle** pressure
"I have experience of five years." O certo é **I have five years of experience.**
"I did a lot of progress." **Progress** é incontável e usa make: **I made a lot of progress.**
"I'm graduated in law." O certo é **I graduated in law** ou **I have a law degree.**
"I want to realize my dream" é comum no sentido de perceber. Para realizar um sonho: **achieve / make my dream come true.**

lessons.title: Formação de palavras e collocations
lessons.goal: Dominar a gramática da unidade: formação de palavras com sufixos e prefixos (-ment, -ness, -ity, -ful, -less, un-, im-, dis-, mis-, re-) e collocations.

head: Tipo
Exemplos
Uso
rows: achieve → achievement; decide → decision; kind → kindness; able → ability
success → successful; hope → hopeless; rely → reliable; create → creative
Negativos: un-, im-, in-, dis-, ir-, il-
unhappy, impossible, inactive, dishonest, irregular, illegal
Outros prefixos: mis-, re-, over-, under-

aula.text: Como atacar um exercício de formação de palavras

items: Olhe a **posição**: antes de substantivo precisa de adjetivo; depois de artigo, substantivo; depois de verbo, advérbio.
Veja se o sentido é **negativo** (prefixo) ou **plural** (-s).
"She is a very success person." Antes de substantivo vem adjetivo: **successful.**
"He solved the problem easy." Verbo pede advérbio: **easily.**
"It was a very disapointing day." Cuidado com a ortografia: **disappointing.**
